desc: Fast, capable, and high performance, the Bonneville brings lightweight strength and everyday reliability to your pocket. Built to move with purpose, this USA-made folder delivers smooth operation with a thumb stud or flipper and confident lockup with DuraLock, keeping your fingers safely out of the blade's path. The 14C28N blade features a thin, hollow grind for clean, precise cuts across daily tasks. A textured glass-filled nylon handle provides a secure grip without extra weight, while the slim profile carries easily. Finished with a reversible deep-carry clip, the Bonneville keeps pace wherever the day takes you.
